# routeros_interface_bridge_mdb (Resource)


## Example Usage
```terraform
resource "routeros_interface_bridge_mdb" "mdb" {
  bridge = "example"
  group  = "IPv4"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `bridge` (String) The bridge interface the multicast group entry belongs to.
- `group` (String) The IPv4 or IPv6 multicast group address of the entry.

### Optional

- `___id___` (Number) <em>Resource ID type (.id / name). This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___path___` (String) <em>Resource path for CRUD operations. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `comment` (String)
- `disabled` (Boolean)
- `interface` (List of String) Bridge ports that are going to receive the traffic of this multicast group.
- `vid` (Number) VLAN ID of the entry. Only relevant when VLAN filtering is enabled on the bridge.

### Read-Only

- `dynamic` (Boolean) Configuration item created by software, not by management interface. It is not exported, and cannot be directly modified.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `invalid` (Boolean)
- `on_interface` (String) The interface the multicast group was learned on.

## Import
Import is supported using the following syntax:
```shell
#The ID can be found via API or the terminal
#The command for the terminal is -> :put [/interface/bridge/mdb get [print show-ids]]
terraform import routeros_interface_bridge_mdb.mdb "*1"
```
